comment: Envoi's mark: the signature block as a letter, stamped into a seal. The E's three arms are the three lines of a signature block — name, title, contact — which is why they differ in length. Geometry lives here rather than in either consumer so the app (components/BrandMark.tsx) and the asset generator (scripts/generate-brand.mjs) cannot drift apart, the same arrangement socialIconSvgs.json already uses.
